$comment: Companion repos cloned alongside Claude-Installer rather than vendored into it. Anything large, independently versioned, or useful on its own belongs here. Claude-Provision.ps1 clones on first run and fast-forwards after that. ${env:VAR} in 'dir' resolves from .env or machine env; unset falls back to 'default'. Cloning uses gh when available so private repos work without a credential helper.

repos.name: design-inspo-library
repos._note: 114 curated web design plates with a three-axis taxonomy. Large because it holds the images and mp4 captures. Not vendored into Claude-Installer -- it would multiply the installer's size by 25x for content Claude only reads the index of.
